bypassCommentPatterns.fix: Remove the eslint-disable comment and fix the underlying lint/architecture violation.
Remove the ignore comment and resolve the analyzer warning at its root cause.
Replace the workaround with a proper implementation in core/, platform/, or ui-kit/.

scopedRules.message: Direct fetch() call in features/ is forbidden.
scopedRules.fix: Move the HTTP request into platform/ (e.g. web/src/platform/api-client.js) and call it via platform/ interface.

scopedRules.message: Direct axios usage in features/ is forbidden.
scopedRules.fix: Wrap axios inside platform/ and expose a domain-level client function.

scopedRules.message: Direct useEffect() in features/ is forbidden.
scopedRules.fix: Encapsulate side-effects and data-fetching hooks inside ui-kit/ or platform/.

scopedRules.message: Direct fs module import in server/routes/ is forbidden.
scopedRules.fix: Use server/scanners/ for read-only file scanning or server/vault/ for encrypted secret writes.
